movelist.name: Trick
movelist.effect: Both targets must be hit for Trick to succeed. The user may target itself or willing allies with Trick; you do not need to roll for Accuracy Check in these cases. Both targets lose their Held Item or Accessory Slot Item, and gain the other target’s Held Item or Accessory Slot Item. If a target has no Item, it still can gain the other target’s Item.

movelist.name: Magic Coat
movelist.effect: If the user is about to get a hit by a Move that does not have a Damage Dice Roll, they may use Magic Coat as an Interrupt. The Interrupted Move’s user is treated as if they were the target of their own Move, with the user of Magic Coat as the user.

movelist.name: Ally Switch
movelist.effect: Ally Switch may be declared during a foe’s turn as an Interrupt. The user chooses one willing ally within 6 meters; the target and the user switch places. If the ally was a target of a Move, the user is now the target; If the user was a target of a Move, the ally is now the target.

movelist.name: Astonish
movelist.effect: Astonish Flinches the target on 15+. Once per scene, if the target is unaware of the user’s presence, Astonish automatically Flinches the target.

movelist.name: Destiny Bond
movelist.effect: All enemy targets in the burst become Bound to the user until the end of the user’s next turn. If a Bound target causes the user to Faint through a Damaging Attack, the Bound target immediately faints after their attack is resolved.

abilities.name: Magician
abilities.effect: The user takes the target’s Held Item. This Ability may not be triggered if the user is already holding a Held Item.

abilities.name: Run Away
abilities.effect: The user does not provoke Attacks of Opportunity by Shifting.  The user cannot be Trapped.
